governance_context.executive_summary: Modernization of clinical analytics data pipelines into AWS cloud infrastructure.

charter.project_purpose: Migrate on-premise clinical trial analytics pipelines to AWS with automated CI/CD and SOC2 compliance.
delivery_objectives: Deploy production-grade AWS infrastructure via Terraform
Migrate and automate ETL pipelines for clinical analytics
Establish automated testing and compliance reporting
success_criteria: Zero data loss during pipeline cutover
Full sign-off by Pfizer Architecture and Compliance leads
exclusions: Legacy data cleansing prior to migration
key_deliverables_summary: DEL-02: Automated CI/CD Data Ingestion Pipeline
major_startup_risks: Client IAM and AWS account provisioning delays
charter.escalation_path: Talent PM / Delivery Manager -> PMO Lead -> Director, PMO

customer_obligations: Provide AWS account access and role credentials
Review deliverable submissions within 5 business days
assumptions: Core team operates remotely across Eastern time zone
Pfizer security review board approves standard Terraform modules
constraints: HIPAA and 21 CFR Part 11 regulatory compliance
platform_environment_commitments: AWS Cloud Infrastructure (EKS, S3, RDS PostgreSQL, IAM)
dependencies: Third-party clinical EDC system API access tokens
sow_interpretation.approval_expectations: Formal written approval from Pfizer Engineering Lead within 5 business days.
ambiguity_notes: Automated pipeline UAT threshold not defined of project baseline.
confirmation_required_items: project baseline work item '' cited in contract ambiguity AMB-01 is not mapped to any baseline deliverable. [CONFIRMATION REQUIRED]

contract_ambiguities.conflicting_clauses: Section 4.2 states acceptance requires 'complete client satisfaction' whereas Section 2.1 defines automated pytest validation suite.
contract_ambiguities.risk_impact: Subjective sign-off criteria could lead to prolonged review cycles and milestone delays.
contract_ambiguities.recommended_clarification: Align contractual acceptance criteria to objective automated test passing metrics.

contract_ambiguities.conflicting_clauses: Proposal schedule commits Milestone 2 delivery by 2026-11-15, but SOW Table 3 lists 2026-11-30.
contract_ambiguities.risk_impact: 2-week schedule discrepancy between commercial proposal and signed SOW baseline.
contract_ambiguities.recommended_clarification: Confirm 2026-11-30 as the binding contractual date for M2 Production Go-Live.

commercial_guardrails.contract_type_implication: Time and Materials contract: Weekly burn oversight and milestone alignment.

commercial_guardrails.commercial_exposure_note: Client dependency delays must be logged in RAID to prevent unfunded burn.
commercial_guardrails.approved_work_rule: Only explicitly contracted SOW scope and approved Change Orders are authorized for execution.
commercial_guardrails.non_approved_work_rule: Tasks exceeding agreed monthly burn ceiling require written client authorization.
commercial_guardrails.work_at_risk_rule: Work-at-risk requires written PMO Lead approval and executive exception sign-off.

commercial_guardrails.change_order_route: PMO Lead leads -> DM aligns client -> Client approves -> Contracting issues change order.
commercial_guardrails.escalation_threshold: Budget burn rate exceeding weekly cap by >10%
